title: Bilevel Coordinated Reflection: A Game-Theoretic Approach to Multi-Agent LLM Systems
abstract: arXiv:2609.02750v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Multi-agent LLM systems commonly use an orchestrator to decompose a task for a team of workers and then improve through textual reflection. Despite strong empirical results, these systems lack a unified account of coordination, memory improvement, and the role of external verification. We model orchestrator-worker interaction as a bilevel coordination game: under bounded coupling, the workers' local-update game is an approximate potential game whose equilibrium slack is controlled by decomposition quality. We then analyse reflection as stochastic movement over semantic memory states. For free-form reflection, we derive a finite-time upper bound, prove worst-case tightness, and give a positive lower bound under a falsifiable persistent-harm condition. translated_title: 双层协调反思：多智能体大语言模型系统的博弈论方法
translated_abstract: 多智能体大语言模型系统通常使用一个协调者将任务分解给一组工作者，随后通过文本反思进行改进。尽管这类系统具有强大的实证表现，但它们缺乏对协调机制、记忆改进以及外部验证作用的统一理论解释。我们将协调者-工作者之间的交互建模为一个双层协调博弈：在有界耦合条件下，工作者的局部更新博弈构成一个近似势博弈，其均衡松弛度由任务分解质量所控制。接着，我们将反思分析为语义记忆状态上的随机运动。对于自由形式的反思，我们推导出有限时间上界，证明了最坏情况下的紧性，并在一个可证伪的持续危害条件下给出了正的下界。我们进一步证明了一个信息论不可能性结果：仅观察生成文本记录的门控无法在文本不可区分的环境中实现一致改进，而（原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文将多智能体LLM系统的协调者-工作者交互建模为双层协调博弈、将反思建模为语义记忆状态上的随机运动，从而给出协调、记忆与外部验证的统一理论框架，并证明了仅凭生成文本的门控无法实现一致改进的信息论不可能性结果。
en_tdlr: This work models orchestrator-worker interaction in multi-agent LLM systems as a bilevel coordination game and reflection as stochastic movement over semantic memory states, deriving finite-time bounds for reflection and proving an information-theoretic impossibility that any gate observing only generated transcripts cannot uniformly improve over text-indistinguishable environments.
